ns2:course.label: Gender&Sexuality Latina/o Lit
ns2:course.description: Examination of questions of gender, sexuality, and identity in contemporary Latina/Latino culture through a discussion of novels, performance pieces, essays and films. Spanish majors must complete writing assignments in Spanish. Same as LLS 246. Prerequisite: 200-level course in LLS literature or culture, or SPAN 200.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Literature and the Arts, and US Minority Culture(s) course.
